import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { NoteId } from "./note-id.ts";

describe("NoteId", () => {
  test("generates a different identity each time", () => {
    expect(NoteId.generate().equals(NoteId.generate())).toBe(false);
  });

  test("parses a UUID and refuses anything else", () => {
    const id = NoteId.parse("7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7");
    expect(id.ok && id.value.value).toBe("7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7");
    expect(NoteId.parse("not-a-uuid").ok).toBe(false);
  });

  test("serialises to its UUID", () => {
    const id = NoteId.generate();
    expect(id.toJSON()).toBe(id.value);
  });
});

describe("NoteId — boundaries", () => {
  test("accepts a UUID", () => {
    expect(NoteId.parse("16fd2706-8baf-433b-82eb-8c7fada847da").ok).toBe(true);
  });

  test("refuses the empty string and a UUID missing a digit", () => {
    expect(NoteId.parse("").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(NoteId.parse("16fd2706-8baf-433b-82eb-8c7fada847d").ok).toBe(false);
  });
});
